verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents an automatic audit trail covering 'all work that occurs in Hummingbird,' plus one-click case-information download and a History export of case data with comments. It also positions its agent-plus-team workflow as keeping 'every decision defensible.' However, no source says the audit trail is timestamped, that it is itself exportable or queryable (rather than general case data), or that it records automated/agent decisions separately from human ones. Missing for 10: explicit timestamps on audit entries, a documented way to retrieve or export the audit log itself (UI or API), explicit coverage of automated decisions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
